editorial: Today, hybrid reasoning agents and high-efficiency large language models are at the forefront of the developer ecosystem. While discussions on Hacker News focus on the human factor behind software, new models like DeepSeek and MiniCPM continue to push performance boundaries on Hugging Face.

items.title: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
items.summary: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search is an AI framework that runs on Claude Code and automates the job search process on your local computer. It performs tasks such as evaluating job postings, editing resumes, preparing cover letters, and conducting interview preparation on behalf of the user.

snapshot.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.

items.title: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
items.summary: Managed by Anthropic, claude-plugins-official is an official directory containing high-quality plugins developed for Claude Code. This resource, prepared in Python, brings together tools that users can utilize in AI-assisted coding processes.

snapshot.description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.

items.title: anomalyco/opencode
items.summary: anomalyco/opencode is an open-source coding agent accessible and open for development by everyone. Developed in TypeScript, this tool aims to provide AI-assisted automation in software processes.

snapshot.description: The open source coding agent.

items.title: cursor/plugins
items.summary: Cursor offers a repository hosting plugin specifications and official plugins developed for the code editor Cursor. Prepared in TypeScript, this resource defines the standards necessary for developers to create their own plugins.

items.title: ruvnet/ruflo
items.summary: Developed with TypeScript, ruflo is a toolkit designed to coordinate autonomous workflows and create multi-agent AI swarms. It facilitates building complex systems with features such as adaptive memory, self-learning capability, and vector-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

snapshot.description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. items.title: stablyai/orca

snapshot.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

snapshot.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.

items.title: Xiaomi-Lens-0 Technical Report
items.summary: Xiaomi-Lens-0 is a 4-billion parameter model developed to address the shortcomings of multimodal large language models in understanding visual details. Built on Qwen3.5, this system performs mask prediction based on visual representations, allowing for more precise analysis of specific regions within an image.

snapshot.description: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) answer questions about whole images well, yet they still struggle with fine-grained region understanding. A key reason is that text-only supervision never specifies which regions support an answer. To close this gap, we present Xiaomi-Lens-0, a 4B MLLM built on Qwen3.5 that predicts masks from its own visual representations. items.title: MTEdit: Packed Trajectories Beat Rollouts for Multi-Turn Image Editing
items.summary: MTEdit, shared by Hugging Face, is a dataset aimed at reducing error accumulation and visual-quality drift in multi-stage image editing processes. Unlike traditional sequential processing methods, it aims to improve human-AI collaborative editing processes by using packed trajectories.

snapshot.description: Multi-turn image editing aims to modify an image according to a sequence of instructions, making it better aligned with human-AI collaborative creation than single-turn editing. However, constructing high-quality multi-turn training data remains challenging, as conventional sequential rollout accumulates errors and introduces visual-quality drift across editing turns. items.title: LiveMACE: Process-Aware Evaluation of LLM Agent Capabilities in Evolving Markets
items.summary: LiveMACEBench is a benchmark tool that evaluates the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) through a process-oriented approach across volatile financial markets. This system focuses not only on the results agents achieve but also on the processes they use to generate those results and their ability to adapt to external conditions.

snapshot.description: Evaluating agents by outcomes alone can obscure the capabilities that produce them. This problem is especially pronounced in evolving environments, where outcomes reflect a closed-loop interaction between agent behavior and changing external conditions. items.title: Scene-Designer: Learning Design Intelligence for Agentic 3D Scene Generation
items.summary: Scene-Designer is an artificial intelligence framework designed to create 3D interior scenes from natural language. The system aims to increase the consistency and usability of scenes by combining design and critique processes.

glossary.explanation: A fundamental working skeleton that accelerates the software development process and offers specific rules and structures.
Small utility programs used to extend the features of the main software or add new capabilities.
A type of software whose source code is open for everyone to examine, modify, and improve.
A method that enables artificial intelligence to scan and use external data to generate responses with more accurate and up-to-date information.
A text-based interface that allows you to manage programs by entering written commands instead of using a mouse.
A storage area that allows artificial intelligence to retain past interactions and information for a long time and recall them in subsequent operations.
Directive commands written to ask artificial intelligence to perform a specific action or provide a response.
An attempt to disable the safety filters or restrictions of artificial intelligence models.
Autonomous artificial intelligence systems that automate software development processes, write code, and debug.
Running software on a remote server accessed via the internet instead of on your own computer.
Specialized capabilities that a piece of software or artificial intelligence possesses to perform specific tasks.
Artificial intelligence models trained on vast amounts of data that can understand human language and generate text.
A software tool that repairs old or low-quality videos and improves image clarity.
An artificial intelligence technique that generates images or processes data step-by-step, starting from random noise.
An abstract space where artificial intelligence represents data mathematically and complex relationships are expressed with numerical values.
Technology that analyzes visual content and generates text that identifies or describes this content.
